song.title: Calculated Grind
song.description: Reps, numbers and quiet determination. Choose the 2:00 version or the 2:28 Focused Trap Mix, play Calculated Grind and read the lyrics for each recording.

update.title: Calculated Grind — Focused Trap Mix
update.summary: The 2:28 Focused Trap Mix joins the 2-minute version. Choose a recording and read its lyrics on the Calculated Grind page.
update.cardSummary: Every day in the gym is my throne. Pick your version.

lyrics.text:
[Verse 1]
It’s a steady engine, hear it hum inside my mind
Every target in the mirror keeps me cold and laser-focused
When I’m pushin’ through the final fuel
Tunnel vision in the silence, see the steel bend when I breathe
Crowd fades, I feel the calm when the big weight rises
All that noise up on the screen
I’ve been planning with the voices
I just need you showin’ up, I just need you addin’ up
Let the numbers back it up, run it up, run it up
Grind mode every day, every set, let the veins glow
When the weight gets heavy, let your will show
I’ve been locked all in, this is beast mode
Turn it up, turn it up, sweat flow
Every rep in the pocket, let the strength grow
When it lines up right, let the proof show
Every day in the gym is my throne
Let it ride, let it ride, let it ride, let it ride
Let it ride, let it ride, let it ride, let it ride

[Verse 2]
Pushing on the muscle while I tighten up my mind
Every second on the clock, I’ve been trackin’, I’ve been grindin’
Turn the struggle to a mantra, hear the order in the timing
All the chatter in the background, I reduce it to a hum
If it’s not about the progress, let it fade, let it go numb
Every curl, every layer, every lift, every press
Got this method in the training, feel it workin’ in my chest
I’m not chasin’ any gimmick, I’ve been sculptin’ out my frame
When they mention all the progress, they gon’ recognize the change
If they see it in the mirror, they gon’ feel it in their breath
I’ve been liftin’ with intention, now I’m climbin’ to my best
Run it up, run it up, grind mode every day, every set
Let the veins glow when the weight gets heavy, let your will show
I’ve been locked all in, this is beast mode
Turn it up, turn it up, sweat flow
Every rep in the pocket, let the strength grow
When it lines up right, let the proof show
Every day in the gym is my throne
lyrics.snippet: Let the numbers back it up, run it up, run it up
